title: Imagery registration: jericho
frame: place frame: metres from the place anchor in atlas/app/atlas-data.json, x east, z south, MapLibre Mercator scaled at the anchor (tools/build_osm_context.py Frame)
turnConvention: turnDegClockwise: the plan's page axes are turned clockwise on the map by this angle (east towards south); pxPerM: plan pixels per metre; planPoint (pixels) lands on placePoint (place frame)

imagery.service: Esri World Imagery (World_Imagery MapServer), zoom-18 tiles; metadata from its identify query at the place anchor
imagery.use: measurement only; tiles and resampled images are not archived (Esri terms of use)

method: The plan is matched to Vantor WorldView-2 imagery (Esri World Imagery, 21 October 2023, 0.5 m, stated accuracy 5 m) by searching the turn, scale and shift that put its dark pixels on the imagery's edges (tools/imagery_registration.py fit), then checked by overlay and an independent part or source.

figures.citation: Trümper 2018 Fig. 18, p. 281 (after Netzer 2001 p. 6 fig. 8): Hasmonean winter palaces with pools; 0–30 m bar, north arrow
figures.excluded: phase legend, north arrow and bar, caption, and the large northern enclosure that lies under today's village: [0,0,440,230], [0,700,300,820], [0,820,1040,900], [380,0,730,270]

checks.pools: the two Phase 3 pools land on two pits visible in the imagery, separated by a light strip about 3 m wide
checks.shadowTilt: the shadows of the pools' south walls in the imagery run 12–16° clockwise from east–west, independently of the fit
checks.otherParts: the pavilion south of the pools, the Twin Palaces and the eastern building land on excavated remains
checks.scale: fitted 4.238 px/m is 0.5 % from the bar

tracedFrame.fig18Transform: x + i*z = a*(px + i*py) + b, a = 0.2404264 + 0.0108087i, b = -121.4574 - 76.3833i (traced record); frame origin at Fig. 18 pixel (518.4, 294.4)
tracedFrame.northOffset: the traced (Netzer) frame north lies 2.57° clockwise of Fig. 18's arrow; with the fit, Netzer's north is 10.58° anticlockwise of true north

placement.note: the traced frame's origin is put on the target and the frame turned 10.58° clockwise (rotationDeg is anticlockwise); the frame's scale is kept (Netzer's plans at their bars; Fig. 18 differs by 2 %)

uncertainty_m: about 3 at the pools; the imagery's own stated accuracy is 5
